result.stdout:
A lossless C# formatter that reads .editorconfig (csharp_* and resharper_*) and .DotSettings files. With no subcommand it formats the given paths in place.

Usage: csharp-format [PATH]... [COMMAND]

Commands:
  format   Format files in place
  check    Check formatting without writing; exits with status 1 when files would change
  stdin    Format standard input and write the result to standard output
  config   Print the resolved formatting options for a path
  explain  Explain which configuration files apply to a path and what they set
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Arguments:
  [PATH]...
          Files or directories to format (defaults to the current directory)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

result.stdout:
Format files in place

Usage: csharp-format format [OPTIONS] [PATH]...

Arguments:
  [PATH]...  Files or directories to format (defaults to the current directory)

Options:
      --no-config             Ignore .editorconfig/.DotSettings and use built-in defaults
  -v, --verbose               Print configuration warnings and per-file diagnostics
      --include-build-output  Also walk files inside bin/ and obj/ build output directories
      --stdout                Write the formatted result to standard output instead of modifying files
      --diff                  Print a unified diff instead of writing files
  -j, --jobs <JOBS>           Parallel worker threads (0 selects the number of CPUs) [default: 0]
  -h, --help                  Print help

Format standard input and write the result to standard output

Usage: csharp-format stdin [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --no-config             Ignore .editorconfig/.DotSettings and use built-in defaults
  -v, --verbose               Print configuration warnings and per-file diagnostics
      --include-build-output  Also walk files inside bin/ and obj/ build output directories
      --file-name <PATH>      Resolve configuration as if the input came from this file name
      --check                 Exit with status 1 when the input is not already formatted
      --diff                  Print a unified diff instead of the formatted source
  -h, --help                  Print help
